card.name: Duration and frequency words after a time phrase
card.fires_on: Small words that begin a duration or repeat-interval phrase, such as every, per, a, for, since, over, all. They follow a verb, dose, or time span and come before a number or time unit.

modes.label: Dosing interval
modes.description: The word every, per, a or for opens a schedule after a dose or infusion time.

modes.label: Duration in narrative
modes.description: A word such as all, since, over or several begins a span of time in ordinary prose.
modes.example: to whom he was close<< all>> his life, was born the following year

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning always or forever, so the text moves toward a bounded time span.
card.plain: It marks the little word that begins how often or how long something happens, like every 3 weeks.
